conclusion: The pilot shows evidence that v10 can recover the published interval into a Top-3 shortlist, but it does not validate final Top-1 selection or overall ranking.
limitations: All 16 pools are selected Vpick-miss cases; Vpick Hit@K is therefore zero by construction and is not an unbiased head-to-head estimate.
The handover specified one isolated request per candidate, while this pilot used one-candidate-at-a-time direct assessment in a single session.
Only 16 of 94 published intervals had enough stored contiguous Vpick candidates.
Fourteen pools are POS and only one each is MID and NEG, so bucket-stratified conclusions are not supported.
